note: Rewritten from the original English description of the new species Nasutitermes devrayi in Maiti and Chakraborty 1994; the type locality is Campbell Bay and Bragi Farm on Great Nicobar. In the original the alate was not obtained (IMAGO unknown), so only the soldier and the worker are treated and the alate section is not recorded. The original gives measurements in millimetres, setting the holotype value alongside the range of 10 measured individuals; the original values and ranges are retained verbatim here. Several terms in the original are vague (such as "head index", "head-nasus index", "postcerebral hump" and "pronotum-head index", which are ratios or length ratios) and are transcribed as printed without conversion.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier body length (with the nasus, excluding the antennae) is 3.00—3.43 mm, and the species is close to the Javanese N. javanicus (eastern Sumatra), N. fabricii (Nicobar), N. mollis (Philippines) and N. perparvus (Thailand). From N. javanicus it differs in the much shorter nasus, almost half the length of the head without the nasus (in that species the nasus is as long as or slightly shorter than the head without the nasus); in profile the nasus is much flatter than the rest of the head (in that species the dorsal margin of the head is straight and the base of the nasus is low and raised); and in the antennae with 12 segments and segment 3 the shortest (that species has 12—13 segments and segment 4 the shortest). From N. fabricii it differs in the sparsely hairy head (densely hairy in that species), the mandibles with an apical process (absent in that species), and the head length without the nasus 0.84—0.89 mm (0.79 mm in that species). From N. mollis it differs in the nasus being much flatter than the dorsal margin of the head in profile (in that species it is distinctly raised with a depression at the base of the nasus), the sparsely hairy head (densely covered with white hairs in that species), and the larger size (that species: head with nasus 1.23 mm, head length without nasus 0.75—0.78 mm, head width 0.72—0.74 mm). From N. parvus it differs in the absence of projections on the sides of the nasus base (small projections present in that species), the sparsely hairy base of the head (densely covered with white hairs in that species), and the larger size. From N. perparvus it differs in the larger size (that species: head with nasus 1.01—1.06 mm), the sparsely hairy head (densely covered with short hairs in that species), and the antennae with 12 segments and segment 3 the shortest (that species has 11 segments and segment 4 the shortest).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brownish yellow, nasus dark brown, antennae brownish yellow; pronotum pale brownish yellow with the anterior lobe darker; legs pale yellow. The head bears very short hairs and a few long erect setae. Body length (with the nasus, excluding the antennae) 3.00—3.43 mm. The head (without the nasus) is oval, longer than wide, its posterior margin nearly straight and slightly concave in the middle; the nasus is conical and stout, about half as long as the head without the nasus, with a tuft of short hairs at its tip; the frontal gland and its duct are distinct. The antennae have 12 segments: segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3, segments 2 and 4 about equal in length, segment 3 the shortest. The mandibles are vestigial, each with a short spine-like apical process. The pronotum is strongly saddle-shaped, twice as wide as long and about half the head width; its anterior lobe is strongly raised, its anterior margin nearly rounded and slightly concave in the middle, with microtrichia on the margins. The legs are short, the tibial spur formula 2:2:2. The abdomen is elongate; the cerci have 2 segments; there is no stylet. Measurements (holotype / range of 10 individuals, mm): head length with nasus 1.32 / 1.24—1.32; head length without nasus 0.89 / 0.84—0.89; nasus length 0.43 / 0.38—0.43; maximum nasus width 0.20 / 0.20; maximum head width 0.80 / 0.70—0.80; maximum head height 0.58 / 0.50—0.58; head index 0.61 / 0.56—0.64; head-nasus index 0.48 / 0.44—0.50; postcerebral hump 0.36 / 0.32—0.38; maximum pronotum length 0.15 / 0.14—0.19; maximum pronotum width 0.40 / 0.38—0.40; pronotum-head index 0.50 / 0.47—0.54; number of antennal segments 12 / 12.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule brownish yellow; antennae, labrum, pronotum and legs pale yellowish white. Body length (excluding the antennae) 3.34—3.58 mm. The head is nearly square and slightly wider than long, its sides slightly diverging anteriorly, its posterior margin nearly rounded, the Y-shaped suture distinct, and the fontanelle plate white, translucent and central. The antennae have 13 segments: segments 2 and 4 about equal in length, segment 3 the smallest. The postclypeus is strongly swollen and hairy, divided into two halves by the median line; the anteclypeus is trapezoidal, white and bare; the labrum is dome-shaped and wider than long. The mandibles are of the nasutitermes type: the left mandible with 1 apical tooth and 2 marginal teeth (the apical tooth conical; the first marginal tooth pointed and longer than the second; the second marginal tooth far below the first; the molar area short and distinctly serrate); in the right mandible the apical tooth is larger than the first marginal tooth, the first marginal tooth is triangular and larger than the second, and the molar area is long and serrate. The pronotum is strongly saddle-shaped, its anterior lobe strongly raised, its anterior margin rounded and without a notch, its posterior margin broadly rounded with an indistinct concavity. The legs are slender and hairy, the tibial spur formula 2:2:2. The cerci have 2 segments; there is no stylet. Measurements (10 individuals, mm): head length to the lateral base of the mandibles 0.68—0.76; maximum head width 0.80—0.86; maximum head height 0.38—0.53; maximum labrum length 0.21—0.24; maximum labrum width 0.38; maximum pronotum length 0.18—0.23; maximum pronotum width 0.38—0.43.
